verdict.rationale: Open WebUI is driven through natural-language chat. Its docs show plain-language commands that operate product features: saving a procedure as a skill ("Save this whole procedure as a skill called release-checklist"), scheduling recurring tasks ("run the tests every weekday at 9"), and having the agent edit files, search the web and delegate to sub-agents under Allow/Deny approvals. missing for 10: evidence that natural language can control admin/settings configuration (memory editing, for example, is documented as a manual Settings path), independent or hands-on corroboration of NL-driven operation.
